50718585.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to GST-tagged BIR3 domain of XIAP by isothermal titration calorimetry

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed on a MicroCal VP-ITC instrument (Malvern Instruments, Inc., Northampton, MA). The GST-tagged BIR3 domain of XIAP (100 μM) was dialyzed against 20 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, pH 7.4, and loaded into the sample cell. The compound (2 or 47, 100–200 μM) was dissolved in the same buffer and loaded into the syringe. The experiment was performed at 25 °C with 25 injections of 2 μL each, spaced 120 s apart. The stirring speed was set to 307 rpm. Data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (MicroCal) with a one-site binding model. A blank experiment with buffer in the syringe was performed to correct for heat of dilution. The reported values are the average of at least two independent experiments.
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Figure 3. Overlay of docked poses of compounds 4 (gray) and 47 (yellow) in the Smac binding groove of XIAP-BIR3. The inset demonstrates how compound 47 might relieve the steric clash between 4 and Tyr324.
original_paragraph.Table 4: Table 4 Isothermal titration calorimetry measurements (XIAP-BIR3) for compounds 2 and 47. Compound Ka (μM) ΔH (kcal/mol) TΔS (kcal/mol) 2 0.9 -1.3 7.0 47 0.9 -1.9 6.2

assay_conditions.buffer_composition: 20 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT
